title: The First Evolution
summary: Infiltrating the Silent Prison, Ha-Jun finds his active magic dampened by anti-mana pylons. Relying on bone density and martial precision, he defeats the Void Inquisitors to reach the central dungeon.

panels.shot: silent prison parapet wide shot
panels.action: A bleak, lightless fortress of matte-black anti-matter stone under twin crimson moons; zero wind, unnatural dead silence.

panels.shot: ha-jun checking his hands in the null field
panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his hands: the flame on his fingertips flickers and extinguishes in the anti-mana atmosphere.

panels.shot: kuro landing on parapet horn
panels.action: Kuro's body shrinks back to crow size; his horn tips lose their glow: 'Ugh... Nullification field bohot strong hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Spells aur flames kaam nahi karenge. Sirf physical aur innate relic passive weapons chalenge.

panels.shot: ha-jun flexing his left bone gauntlet
panels.action: Ha-Jun's bone gauntlet remains dense and solid; his skeletal reinforcement is biological, immune to dispels.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bone of the Forgotten meri haddiyon ka hissa hai... Is par koi spell dispel kaam nahi karta.

panels.shot: ha-jun tapping the fang of abyss at his hip
panels.action: The Fang of Abyss hums with cold dark space; as a tear in reality, it cannot be canceled by mana fields.

panels.shot: eye of the night blinking inside right socket
panels.action: The starry cosmic eye pierces through the darkness, highlighting structural weak points in the fortress walls.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Eye of the Night bhi kaam kar rahi hai. Ventilation shaft 10 meter aage hai.

panels.shot: two armored void inquisitors patrolling corridor below
panels.action: Two 8-foot tall faceless Void Inquisitors clad in obsidian plate armor, carrying jagged executioner axes.

panels.shot: ha-jun dropping silently from ceiling like a phantom
panels.action: Ha-Jun drops silently from an overhead ventilation shaft, landing directly between the two sentries.

panels.shot: ha-jun striking first sentry with bone elbow
panels.action: Before the sentry can turn, Ha-Jun drives his left bone elbow into the center of the inquisitor's breastplate.

panels.shot: inquisitor breastplate caving inward
panels.action: The solid anti-matter steel plate caves inward three inches; the sentry is knocked unconscious instantly.

panels.shot: second inquisitor raising massive executioner axe
panels.action: The second guard swings a heavy double-bitted axe in a horizontal decapitation arc.

panels.shot: ha-jun ducking beneath the blade with fluid precision
panels.action: Remembering his blindfold training, Ha-Jun ducks smoothly under the axe, stepping into the guard's guard.

panels.shot: ha-jun palm strike to inquisitor chin
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives an open-palm bone strike upward into the sentry's chin, snapping the helmet back.

panels.shot: second sentry slumping limp against the wall
panels.action: The second inquisitor collapses unconscious to the stone floor with zero alarms raised.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto ha-jun shoulder grinning
panels.action: Kuro snickers: 'Clean. Martial discipline bina mana ke bhi lethal hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dekha? Brute magic ke bina tumhara close combat master-class hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun moving down the descending spiral corridor
panels.action: Ha-Jun glides down the spiraling stone corridor, his Eye of the Night tracking the crimson thread.

panels.shot: cells lining the walls holding ancient captive demons
panels.action: Rusted iron cell bars holding emaciated ancient demons, staring at Ha-Jun with hollow, dead eyes.

panels.shot: a captive demon recognizing ha-jun sovereign crest
panels.action: An ancient four-eyed warlock demon gasps, clutching the bars: 'S-Sovereign... The Bloodline lives...!'

dialogue.speaker: captive_demon
dialogue.text: Maha-Sovereign ka khoon laut aaya hai... Humein azaad karo!

panels.shot: ha-jun halting for half a second
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into the captive's desperate eyes: 'Main sabko azaad karunga... Bas thoda sabr rakho.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pehle apne bhai ko nikalunga... Phir is poori prison ko tod dunga.

panels.shot: reaching the central execution rotunda
panels.action: The corridor opens into a massive 100-meter circular subterranean rotunda lit by floating green torches.

panels.shot: kang tae-jun chained to floating central monolith
panels.action: Suspended 30 feet in midair: Kang Tae-Jun, bound by colossal black glowing chains wrapped around his arms and torso.

panels.shot: ha-jun heart stopping at the sight
panels.action: Ha-Jun's breath shatters in his chest; tears well up as he finally lays eyes on his elder brother.

panels.shot: tae-jun slowly lifting bruised face
panels.action: Kang Tae-Jun—with messy dark hair, a scarred jawline, and tired fierce eyes—slowly raises his head.

panels.shot: tae-jun recognizing ha-jun in disbelief
panels.action: Tae-Jun's dry lips part in stunned disbelief: 'H-Ha-Jun...? Tum... Yahan kaise...?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun...? Tum yahan kyu aaye... Bhag jao! Yeh trap hai!

panels.shot: dark throne emerging from the rotunda shadows
panels.action: From the high balcony shadows, a 12-foot demonic figure in feathered violet silk robes steps forward.

panels.shot: grand inquisitor belial design reveal
panels.action: A tall, slender demon lord with four sweeping ram horns, porcelain skin, and a mask of silver weeping tears.

dialogue.speaker: belial
dialogue.text: Welcome to the Silent Rotunda, little Sovereign.

panels.shot: belial holding the master anchor chain in hand
panels.action: In Belial's hand rests the master link of the colossal black chain: 'The Chains of Ruin.'

panels.shot: belial mocking the brothers' reunion
panels.action: Belial smiles with sadistic elegance: 'Your brother endured seven years of torture to keep you safe... And you walk right into my cage!'

dialogue.speaker: belial
dialogue.text: Ab dono bhaiyon ka blood mil kar Demon Lords ke naye empire ki foundation banega!

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the fang of abyss with chilling silence
panels.action: Ha-Jun unsheathes the spatial void dagger, his cosmic galaxy eye burning with absolute zero temperature.

panels.shot: ha-jun pointing the void blade at belial
panels.action: Ha-Jun's voice echoes with ancient imperial authority: 'Mera bhai chhod... Ya apni gardan de.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chains ko azaad kar... Ya main is puri fortress ko tere upar gira doonga.
